description:
Add the verdict record and the archive-evidence record to the generated storage-record reference, so the reference describes every per-key record a reader addresses.

## Background

`docs/reference/storage-records.md` is generated from `crates/jit/src/storage/reference.rs` and checked by a golden test. It describes issue records, gate-run records and event records. It does not describe `gate-runs/verdicts/<gate-key>/<inputs-digest>.json`, which names the run holding a reusable verdict, or `archive-evidence/<target-key>.json`, which holds one archive target's executions. Both are written in the same redo record as the run or execution they describe.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The reference source documents both records: their paths, their fields, which mutation writes them and which reader addresses them, with field rows derived from their types.
- [hard] REQ-02: `docs/reference/storage-records.md` is regenerated from the source and its golden test passes.

## Notes

- Written against the code as it stands after the semantic-types epic (2195c98f): issue ids are `IssueId`, gate-run ids `GateRunId`, gate keys `GateKey`, lease ids `LeaseId`, events are an `Event` envelope around a tagged `EventBody`, and record paths come from `VirtualPath` constructors. Line citations name current code, which that epic retypes.
title: The storage-record reference describes verdict and archive-evidence records
